payload.summaryEn: Long-term tenants continue to anchor Class A office in Bellevue’s Spring District.
payload.summaryZh: 贝尔维尤 Spring District 甲级写字楼由长期租户持续支撑。
payload.bodyEn: The Spring District Class A office, acquired in February 2024 for $16.28 million, remains leased to premier tenants across from Meta’s campus.
payload.bodyZh: 2024 年 2 月以 1628 万美元收购的 Spring District 甲级写字楼，正对 Meta 园区，持续由优质租户承租。
